mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(t1.CHURI_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS churi_ymd , t1.GYULJE_JM_CD , t1.CHURI_JUSU , t1.AEK , t1.TAX_AEK , t1.WON_AEK , t1.WON_TAX_AEK , t1.GROSS_UP_AEK , TO_CHAR(yg.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , yg.TR_CD , yg.FUND_CD , ia.FUND_NM AS szm0ia_fund_nm , yg.JM_CD , ya.JM_NM AS sym0ya_jm_nm , yg.TRUSTEE , yg.CURRENCY , TO_CHAR(yg.HWAKJ_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS hwakj_ymd , yg.TAX_AEK AS yg_tax_aek , yg.GYULJE_AEK AS yg_gyulje_aek , CASE WHEN yg.CHURI_YMD IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS chk , t1.CORP_GR , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.PYUNGA_JOIN , ROWIDTOCHAR(yg.ROWID) AS yg_rowid , ia.FUND_CURRENCY , t1.FCUR_GYULJE_AEK , t1.FCUR_HWAN_CHA , t1.GYULJE_AEK , t1.WON_GYULJE_AEK FROM SYT0YG_PYUNGA t1 JOIN SYT0YG yg ON yg.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND yg.PYUNGA_JOIN = t1.PYUNGA_JOIN JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = yg.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = yg.FUND_CD JOIN SYM0YA ya ON ya.CORP_GR = yg.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = yg.JM_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND yg.TR_CD IN ('G12', 'G17') ORDER BY yg.FUND_CD ASC

SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.CHURI_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM SYT0YG_PYUNGA t1 JOIN SYT0YG yg ON yg.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND yg.PYUNGA_JOIN = t1.PYUNGA_JOIN WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND yg.TR_CD IN ('G12', 'G17') AND t1.CHURI_YMD IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ymd
SELECT JM_CD FROM SYM0YA WHERE CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND CURRENCY = #{currency} AND GYULJE_JM = 'Y' AND JASAN_GB = '5' FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE SYT0YG SET CHURI_YMD = CASE WHEN #{churiYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND #{churiYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} != '' THEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{churiYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE NULL END WHERE ROWID = CHARTOROWID(#{ygRowid, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
